dossier.headline: IT turns from November laggard to market support
dossier.summary: IT had been November's weakest sector on AI worries, but on Monday 23 Nov it was the only sector to close higher, led by TCS, as the rest of the market sold off. On 25 Nov the IT majors rose up to 4% early as India caught up with the global tech rally it missed on Tuesday's holiday, and IT stayed among the outperformers into the afternoon.
why_it_matters: IT has cushioned the market on both a down day and an up day this week
The sector's moves are tied to how global tech and AI valuations trade
